message: Vector Rebel 3.2.85: Simple Captain full-gear status and BC shift summary using shared background verification receipts.
releaseNotes: C-shift Master now has two simple report entrypoints: Daily Captain Check lists every known PPE item per firefighter with source-labeled native inspection status, and BC Check shows one summary row per firefighter. Both read the existing Rebel Command ledger on opening and do not automatically repeat a full all-item Vector history scan. Both expose a single Check outstanding action and a small collapsed Setup/troubleshooting section; historic Captain two-month reports are preserved through an optional archived view, with rebuild only by explicit selection. Correct staffing editor is collapsed. A dedicated authorized signed-in Vector tab may be armed once for rotating background rechecks across future C tours while that browser tab stays open; outside C tours it waits without scanning. Pending does not mean missed, and no CrewSense writes or official inspections occur automatically.
